Quick Guide

Enter the learner's basic information and upload an optional 2 × 2 photo.
Use Save Learner for a new record, then Edit Record to enter grades, attendance and comments.
Use the Term 1, 2 and 3 menu buttons to jump directly to the corresponding grade columns.
Save the record first, then choose Generate / Print Exact SF9 Card.
